source_evidence: Day328~11:08 exact player 'Im all in' answers Harthvale's question about investor or operating partner, expressing broad interest in both under the established commercial pretext. It does not authorize an unspecified payment, actual access to holdings, signed agreement, use of employees, violence, or particular unlawful act. Harthvale is pleased and voluntarily advances preliminary nonbinding terms following the already successful Deception25/DC17&22. He suggests V match the existing alternative patron's prospective250gp capital offer, with use of V's private facilities separately negotiated against actual availability, and V participating in decisions subject to the three existing households' assent and an agreed share; no exclusivity, actual equity fraction, capital call, facility transfer or approved capacity assumed. He writes a short signed memorandum headed 'For discussion only — Proposed capital participation: 250 gp; use of private berth and storage by separate agreement; participation in association decisions subject to assent of existing members and agreed terms. No funds or access due until final agreement. — Demeric Harthvale.' He voluntarily gives it to V for consideration; V retains offered paper, does not sign. New prospective terms derive from fixed250gp alternative patron offer and existing three-household organization in prep/dm-only/dm-ferry-setup.md @72d5bde0ab9d84d89fdc63f20cf9c7bfb63b1516; not a preexisting document or accepted deal. Harthvale proposes that before any commitment, the association's accounts custodian prepare a summary of actual business for V to review and the other households be consulted; no custodian attendance, actual account access, dispatch or assent yet. On V's reference to dirt, Harthvale says 'When a man gives us his word, I expect him to keep it. I have no use for needless trouble on the river.' No specific violence, coercion, victim, assignment or unrelated crime revealed or authorized. Cirren independently says 'We would need to see the accounts and understand the obligations before agreeing to terms.' Mara supports reviewing proposal; Fenar observes. Harthvale asks if they wish him to arrange the accounts review. All four hear conversation. Desen not yet briefed on today's discoveries. No new contested check; voluntary preliminary terms flow from prior successful concrete-proposal threshold and V's stated interest. No money spent, no other resource change, no binding partnership.
